items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jim Hill was up in that section there too. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] The bass player. The bass player was, he was down between Libby and Marais. Yeah, he was there.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then after I left, due to war, he was staying with Kid Howard. Yeah, that's what I mean, he moved. Yeah, that's when he stayed across the street from, but I had left then. Yeah, you left then. Uh, so I played with a lot of fellas.
Jim Hill was up in that section there too. Yeah.

The bass player. The bass player was, he was down between Libby and Marais. Yeah, he was there. Yeah, I think he's still there yet if you all can move. No, he moved this summer. Did he? I don't know where. I don't have his address. Oh, yeah. Jim Robinson knows, I'm sure.
